name: Laxmi Narayana Mula Venkata
headline: Data Engineer
summary: Data Engineer with 17+ years of experience in data engineering, quality engineering, and cloud technologies. Hands-on experience building and orchestrating ETL pipelines on Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Apache Airflow/Cloud Composer) using Python and SQL, with data governance experience including lineage, audit logging, schema validation, and column-level access control using Google policy tags. Experienced in translating business rules into PySpark transformations, production support, and Docker and Jenkins CI/CD. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable, scalable data solutions.
